audit.mode: read-only; no provider calls, no paid input changes
audit.statement: Evidence inventory of the paid HOB run, not a validation of the model's semantic output. Each retained capability fact is listed under its producing run with face, role, and an evidence fingerprint, so Main can join ledger rows to the artifact's oracle_facts by exact tuple without reconstructing identities.
audit.classification_caveat: Card dispositions below record what the run retained and what it recorded as missing; they do not endorse a capability whose Oracle text contradicts it. Three cards carry explicit unsupported dispositions (see classification_ledger.unsupported_representation): hone counters on 103562, gift on 103372, and 103508, whose Oracle text untaps a creature you control while the retained role says disabling_removal. Hone is a representation and relationship gap rather than missing extraction: the printed hone-counter abilities of 103562 and 103534 are retained as facts under generic roles, no hone representation exists, and no hone relationship is confirmed. These are role-vocabulary and representation gaps that belong to a bounded new child of #559; #589 and #590 do not own them, since #590 covers recruit and amass only. Any downstream profile must treat the retained facts as evidence to re-verify, not as accepted truth.

artifact.set_source_note: semantic digest of the run's pinned card database, computed as set_source_sha256() in draftomen/semantic_enrichment.py over the normalized projection of every card (card_id, oracle_id, set code, collector number, name, layout, type_line, oracle_text, faces) rather than over bytes; it is therefore neither the transport digest of the published export gzip (8831da979587...) nor its decompressed payload digest (c6a8ac73a31f...), and it is not the file digest of sources/card-database.json (70ebacdfa4bd8e45f485a6bf7392daf1f754414e0716c6587fcc9e8dc419b9b9). TraceAudit's rebuilt loader reproduces it and records card_database_digest_matches_audit in docs/audits/hob-587-trace-out-r2.json

facts_by_run_join: finding_id is stored in the artifact as '<run_id>:<raw_suffix>'. For every row here, raw_suffix = local_id when the stored suffix did not begin with '<arena_id>-', and raw_suffix = arena_id + '-' + local_id otherwise; the producing run id is the group key and the card id is the group's first element. Join check: for each row, exactly one artifact oracle_facts entry must match on (card_id, face_index, role) and carry evidence_sha256_16; its own finding_id must equal the reconstruction. evidence_sha256_16 is the first 16 hex characters of sha256 over json.dumps(fact['evidence'], sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).
derived_fact_marker: review reason begins 'token_maker is derived from the quoted ability'; compiler-derived by draftomen/set_enrichment_extraction.py:_derived_token_maker_capabilities

unsupported_cards.name: Bilbo's Gambit

unsupported_cards.disposition: unsupported_representation: the guide-seeded gift mechanic has no role; this card is also in the missing-information list

classification_ledger.disposition_note: Dispositions can co-occur per card. missing_information counts cards with no retained facts; unsupported_representation counts cards whose retained or seeded mechanic has no correct closed role. A mechanic retained under generic roles counts as a representation and relationship gap, not as missing information: hone facts are retained for 103562 and 103534 while hone has no dedicated role and no hone relationship exists. Neither count certifies the semantics of the 583 retained facts.

Deciding them is extraction and reconciliation scope, so a bounded new child of #559 must carry the adjudication records; #588 is a different record set and does not own it.

Seeded guidance for hone and gift has no closed-vocabulary role, so hone has no dedicated representation and no hone relationship while the printed hone-counter abilities of 103534 and 103562 are retained as generic facts, and 103508's untap is stored as removal; a bounded new child of #559 must decide the role vocabulary. #589 and #590 do not own these cards, since #590 covers recruit and amass only
